name: @lovelace_lol/embody
description: Renderer-agnostic character animation runtime for facial AUs, visemes, and bone-driven motion

scripts.build: tsup --config tsup.config.mjs && npm run wasm:build && tsc -p tsconfig.declarations.json
scripts.test: npm run rust:test && npm run typecheck && npm run test:annotations
scripts.test:exports: node scripts/smoke/package-exports.mjs && node scripts/smoke/body-controls.mjs && node scripts/smoke/semantic-pose.mjs && node scripts/smoke/morph-authoring.mjs && node scripts/smoke/bilateral-channels.mjs && node scripts/smoke/inherited-starts.mjs && node scripts/smoke/reference-pose.mjs && node scripts/smoke/clip-interpolation.mjs && node scripts/smoke/gaze-focus.mjs && node scripts/smoke/package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test:package: npm run check:dist && npm run test:exports && npm run test:pack && npm run test:annotations
scripts.rust:test: RUSTC=$(rustup which rustc) RUSTDOC=$(rustup which rustdoc) rustup run stable cargo test
scripts.rust:wasm-build: RUSTC=$(rustup which rustc) RUSTDOC=$(rustup which rustdoc) rustup run stable cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release

author: Jonathan Sutton Fields
